sloka: वसिष्ठो वामदेवः च जाबालिः अथ काश्यपः ।मार्कण्डेयः च दीर्घायुः ऋषिः कात्यायनः तथा ॥१-६९-४॥
transliteration: vasiṣṭho vāmadevaḥ ca jābāliḥ atha kāśyapaḥ ।mārkaṇḍeyaḥ ca dīrghāyuḥ ṛṣiḥ kātyāyanaḥ tathā ॥1-69-4॥

translations.english: Let brahmins like Vasishta, Vamadeva, Jabali, Kasyapa, Markandeya endowed with long life, and rishi Katyayana depart in advance. My chariot be yoked and kept ready. Let there be no delay. The messengers (from Janaka) are hastening me up".
translations.hindi: इसी लिए मैं उनके समीर जाती हुई बहुत डरती हूँ। आप कृपया मुझे वहाँ न भेजिए। हे राम! उस डरी हुई रम्भा के यह कहने पर
